definition: The Deep Learning Indaba is an annual conference and educational event that aims to strengthen machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) capacity across Africa.
details: Launched in 2017, it brings together students, researchers, industry practitioners, and policymakers from across the African continent.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. In plain words: The Deep Learning Indaba is an annual conference and educational event that aims to strengthen machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) capacity across Africa. Here is how it actually plays out: Launched in 2017, it brings together students, researchers, industry practitioners, and policymakers from across the African continent. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Deep Learning Indaba.
